hobbies and weekends.pt: No próximo sábado vai ter um show gratuito na praça principal.

hobbies and weekends.text: Yo que tú me apuntaría al club de lectura de la biblioteca.
hobbies and weekends.en: If I were you, I'd join the library's book club.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se eu fosse você, entraria no clube de leitura da biblioteca.

hobbies and weekends.text: Fuimos a un museo de arte moderno, pero a mí no me gustó mucho.
hobbies and weekends.en: We went to a modern art museum, but I didn't like it much.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fomos a um museu de arte moderna, mas eu não gostei muito.

hobbies and weekends.text: Los domingos por la mañana desayunamos tarde y leemos el periódico en la terraza.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sunday mornings we have a late breakfast and read the paper on the terrace.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Aos domingos de manhã tomamos café tarde e lemos o jornal na varanda.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¡Qué bien lo pasamos en el festival de música del año pasado!
hobbies and weekends.en: We had such a great time at last year's music festival!
hobbies and weekends.pt: Como nos divertimos no festival de música do ano passado!

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi novia hace escalada y quiere que yo también lo pruebe.
hobbies and weekends.en: My girlfriend does climbing and wants me to try it too.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Minha namorada faz escalada e quer que eu experimente também.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Prefieres ver series en casa o salir a tomar algo con amigos?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you prefer watching series at home or going out for a drink with friends?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você prefere ver séries em casa ou sair para tomar alguma coisa com os amigos?

hobbies and weekends.text: Este sábado haré limpieza en el jardín y por la tarde descansaré.
hobbies and weekends.en: This Saturday I'll tidy up the garden and in the afternoon I'll rest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste sábado vou arrumar o jardim e à tarde vou descansar.

hobbies and weekends.text: Gonzalo aprendió a cocinar platos japoneses viendo vídeos en internet.
hobbies and weekends.en: Gonzalo learnt to cook Japanese dishes by watching videos online.
hobbies and weekends.pt: O Gonzalo aprendeu a cozinhar pratos japoneses vendo vídeos na internet.

hobbies and weekends.text: Cuando éramos estudiantes, íbamos a conciertos casi todos los fines de semana.
hobbies and weekends.en: When we were students, we went to concerts almost every weekend.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quando éramos estudantes, íamos a shows quase todo fim de semana.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me parece que el ajedrez es un pasatiempo muy bueno para la mente.
hobbies and weekends.en: I think chess is a very good hobby for the mind.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Acho que o xadrez é um passatempo muito bom para a mente.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Vendrías conmigo a una clase de yoga el sábado que viene?
hobbies and weekends.en: Would you come with me to a yoga class next Saturday?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você viria comigo a uma aula de ioga no sábado que vem?

hobbies and weekends.text: El domingo pasado nos levantamos tarde y no hicimos absolutamente nada.
hobbies and weekends.en: Last Sunday we got up late and did absolutely nothing.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo passado acordamos tarde e não fizemos absolutamente nada.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi abuelo hacía crucigramas todas las mañanas para mantener la mente activa.
hobbies and weekends.en: My grandfather did crosswords every morning to keep his mind active.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu avô fazia palavras cruzadas todas as manhãs para manter a mente ativa.

hobbies and weekends.text: Cuando me jubile, dedicaré más tiempo a la jardinería y a viajar.
hobbies and weekends.en: When I retire, I'll devote more time to gardening and travelling.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quando eu me aposentar, vou dedicar mais tempo à jardinagem e a viajar.

hobbies and weekends.text: A Clara le encanta hacer punto mientras escucha la radio.
hobbies and weekends.en: Clara loves knitting while she listens to the radio.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A Clara adora tricotar enquanto ouve rádio.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Has visto ya la exposición de fotografía que hay en el centro cultural?
hobbies and weekends.en: Have you seen the photography exhibition at the cultural centre yet?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você já viu a exposição de fotografia que está no centro cultural?

hobbies and weekends.text: El sábado jugamos un partido de baloncesto y ganamos por diez puntos.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Saturday we played a basketball game and won by ten points.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No sábado jogamos uma partida de basquete e ganhamos por dez pontos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi plan para el domingo es dormir hasta tarde y ver una película.
hobbies and weekends.en: My plan for Sunday is to sleep in and watch a film.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu plano para domingo é dormir até tarde e ver um filme.

hobbies and weekends.text: Hace años que quiero aprender a tocar el piano, pero nunca encuentro tiempo.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've wanted to learn the piano for years, but I never find the time.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Faz anos que quero aprender a tocar piano, mas nunca encontro tempo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Los fines de semana mi familia y yo solemos ir en bici al lago.
hobbies and weekends.en: At weekends my family and I usually cycle to the lake.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Nos fins de semana eu e minha família costumamos ir de bicicleta até o lago.

hobbies and weekends.text: Sería divertido organizar una noche de karaoke con los compañeros de clase.
hobbies and weekends.en: It would be fun to organise a karaoke night with our classmates.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Seria divertido organizar uma noite de karaokê com os colegas de turma.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me apunté a clases de guitarra flamenca, pero lo dejé por falta de tiempo.
hobbies and weekends.en: I signed up for flamenco guitar lessons, but I gave up for lack of time.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Me inscrevi em aulas de violão flamenco, mas desisti por falta de tempo.

home and daily routine.text: Todos los días me levanto a las siete y me ducho antes de desayunar.
home and daily routine.en: Every day I get up at seven and shower before breakfast.
home and daily routine.pt: Todos os dias eu acordo às sete e tomo banho antes do café da manhã.

home and daily routine.text: Cuando vivía con mis padres, nunca tenía que hacer la cena.
home and daily routine.en: When I lived with my parents, I never had to make dinner.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando eu morava com meus pais, nunca precisava fazer o jantar.

home and daily routine.text: Esta tarde pondré la lavadora y tenderé la ropa en el balcón.
home and daily routine.en: This afternoon I'll put a wash on and hang the clothes out on the balcony.
home and daily routine.pt: Hoje à tarde vou ligar a máquina de lavar e estender a roupa na varanda.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Te importa sacar la basura cuando bajes a por el pan?
home and daily routine.en: Do you mind taking the rubbish out when you go down for bread?
home and daily routine.pt: Você se importa de levar o lixo quando descer para comprar pão?

home and daily routine.text: Ayer limpié toda la casa porque venían mis suegros a cenar.
home and daily routine.en: Yesterday I cleaned the whole house because my in-laws were coming to dinner.
home and daily routine.pt: Ontem limpei a casa toda porque meus sogros vinham jantar.

home and daily routine.text: Creo que deberíamos repartir mejor las tareas de la casa.
home and daily routine.en: I think we should share out the household chores better.
home and daily routine.pt: Acho que deveríamos dividir melhor as tarefas de casa.

home and daily routine.text: Por las mañanas siempre tomo un café solo y una tostada con aceite.
home and daily routine.en: In the mornings I always have a black coffee and toast with olive oil.
home and daily routine.pt: De manhã sempre tomo um café preto e uma torrada com azeite.

home and daily routine.text: Nos mudamos a este piso hace dos años y estamos muy contentos.
home and daily routine.en: We moved into this flat two years ago and we're very happy.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós nos mudamos para este apartamento há dois anos e estamos muito contentes.

home and daily routine.text: Antes cogía el autobús para ir a trabajar, pero ahora voy en bici.
home and daily routine.en: I used to take the bus to work, but now I cycle.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes eu pegava o ônibus para ir trabalhar, mas agora vou de bicicleta.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Quién ha dejado los platos sucios en el fregadero otra vez?
home and daily routine.en: Who's left the dirty dishes in the sink again?
home and daily routine.pt: Quem deixou a louça suja na pia de novo?

home and daily routine.text: Me gustaría tener una casa con jardín para poder tener un perro.
home and daily routine.en: I'd like to have a house with a garden so I can have a dog.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu gostaria de ter uma casa com jardim para poder ter um cachorro.

home and daily routine.text: Los lunes llevo a los niños al colegio y luego voy a la oficina.
home and daily routine.en: On Mondays I take the children to school and then go to the office.
home and daily routine.pt: Às segundas levo as crianças à escola e depois vou ao escritório.

home and daily routine.text: Se rompió la calefacción en pleno invierno y pasamos mucho frío.
home and daily routine.en: The heating broke down in the middle of winter and we were really cold.
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecimento quebrou em pleno inverno e passamos muito frio.

home and daily routine.text: Normalmente ceno sobre las nueve y me acuesto antes de las doce.
home and daily routine.en: I usually have dinner around nine and go to bed before twelve.
home and daily routine.pt: Normalmente janto por volta das nove e vou dormir antes da meia-noite.

home and daily routine.text: Mañana vendrá el fontanero a arreglar el grifo de la cocina.
home and daily routine.en: Tomorrow the plumber will come to fix the kitchen tap.
home and daily routine.pt: Amanhã o encanador vem consertar a torneira da cozinha.

home and daily routine.text: Yo pintaría el salón de un color más claro para que tenga más luz.
home and daily routine.en: I'd paint the living room a lighter colour so it gets more light.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu pintaria a sala de uma cor mais clara para que tenha mais luz.

home and daily routine.text: De pequeña, mi madre me despertaba cantando todas las mañanas.
home and daily routine.en: When I was little, my mother woke me up singing every morning.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando eu era pequena, minha mãe me acordava cantando todas as manhãs.

home and daily routine.text: ¿A qué hora sueles volver a casa del trabajo?
home and daily routine.en: What time do you usually get home from work?
home and daily routine.pt: A que horas você costuma voltar do trabalho para casa?

home and daily routine.text: Esta semana me toca a mí fregar los platos y planchar la ropa.
home and daily routine.en: This week it's my turn to wash the dishes and do the ironing.
home and daily routine.pt: Esta semana é a minha vez de lavar a louça e passar a roupa.

home and daily routine.text: Se me olvidaron las llaves dentro y tuve que llamar a un cerrajero.
home and daily routine.en: I left my keys inside and had to call a locksmith.
home and daily routine.pt: Esqueci as chaves dentro de casa e tive que chamar um chaveiro.

home and daily routine.text: Nuestro piso es pequeño, pero tiene mucha luz y unas vistas preciosas.
home and daily routine.en: Our flat is small, but it gets lots of light and has lovely views.
home and daily routine.pt: Nosso apartamento é pequeno, mas tem muita luz e uma vista linda.

home and daily routine.text: Antes de acostarme, siempre preparo la ropa para el día siguiente.
home and daily routine.en: Before going to bed, I always get my clothes ready for the next day.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de dormir, sempre separo a roupa para o dia seguinte.

home and daily routine.text: Cuando terminemos las obras, la cocina será mucho más grande.
home and daily routine.en: When we finish the building work, the kitchen will be much bigger.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando terminarmos a reforma, a cozinha vai ficar muito maior.

home and daily routine.text: Mi compañero de piso nunca limpia el baño y eso me molesta mucho.
home and daily routine.en: My flatmate never cleans the bathroom and that really annoys me.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu colega de apartamento nunca limpa o banheiro e isso me incomoda muito.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Has regado las plantas o lo hago yo esta noche?
home and daily routine.en: Have you watered the plants or shall I do it tonight?
home and daily routine.pt: Você regou as plantas ou eu faço isso hoje à noite?

home and daily routine.text: Los fines de semana no pongo el despertador y me levanto cuando quiero.
home and daily routine.en: At weekends I don't set the alarm and I get up whenever I want.
home and daily routine.pt: Nos fins de semana não ponho o despertador e acordo quando quero.

home and daily routine.text: Anoche se me quemó el arroz porque me puse a ver la tele.
home and daily routine.en: Last night I burnt the rice because I got caught up watching TV.
home and daily routine.pt: Ontem à noite queimei o arroz porque fiquei vendo televisão.

home and daily routine.text: Vivir solo tiene ventajas, pero a veces echo de menos tener compañía.
home and daily routine.en: Living alone has its advantages, but sometimes I miss having company.
home and daily routine.pt: Morar sozinho tem vantagens, mas às vezes sinto falta de companhia.

home and daily routine.text: Mis padres compraron esta casa hace treinta años y nunca la han reformado.
home and daily routine.en: My parents bought this house thirty years ago and have never renovated it.
home and daily routine.pt: Meus pais compraram esta casa há trinta anos e nunca a reformaram.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Podrías poner la mesa mientras yo termino de preparar la cena?
home and daily routine.en: Could you set the table while I finish making dinner?
home and daily routine.pt: Você poderia pôr a mesa enquanto eu termino de preparar o jantar?

home and daily routine.text: Todas las tardes paseo al perro durante media hora por el barrio.
home and daily routine.en: Every afternoon I walk the dog around the neighbourhood for half an hour.
home and daily routine.pt: Todas as tardes passeio com o cachorro pelo bairro durante meia hora.

home and daily routine.text: El año que viene nos mudaremos a una casa más cerca del colegio.
home and daily routine.en: Next year we'll move to a house closer to the school.
home and daily routine.pt: No ano que vem vamos nos mudar para uma casa mais perto da escola.

home and daily routine.text: ¡Qué desorden hay en tu habitación, ordénala antes de salir!
home and daily routine.en: Your room is such a mess, tidy it up before you go out!
home and daily routine.pt: Que bagunça está o seu quarto, arrume antes de sair!

home and daily routine.text: Cuando trabajaba de noche, dormía por las mañanas con las persianas bajadas.
home and daily routine.en: When I worked nights, I slept in the mornings with the blinds down.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando eu trabalhava à noite, dormia de manhã com as persianas fechadas.

home and daily routine.text: Hoy no me apetece cocinar, así que pediremos una pizza.
home and daily routine.en: I don't feel like cooking today, so we'll order a pizza.
home and daily routine.pt: Hoje não estou a fim de cozinhar, então vamos pedir uma pizza.

home and daily routine.text: Me parece que el lavavajillas no funciona bien, porque los vasos salen sucios.
home and daily routine.en: I think the dishwasher isn't working properly, because the glasses come out dirty.
home and daily routine.pt: Acho que a lava-louças não está funcionando bem, porque os copos saem sujos.

home and daily routine.text: Beatriz se levanta a las seis para hacer ejercicio antes de ir a trabajar.
home and daily routine.en: Beatriz gets up at six to exercise before going to work.
home and daily routine.pt: A Beatriz acorda às seis para fazer exercício antes de ir trabalhar.

home and daily routine.text: Compraremos una cama nueva cuando nos devuelvan el dinero de Hacienda.
home and daily routine.en: We'll buy a new bed when we get our tax refund.
home and daily routine.pt: Vamos comprar uma cama nova quando recebermos a restituição do imposto de renda.

home and daily routine.text: Siempre hago la compra los jueves porque el supermercado está más tranquilo.
home and daily routine.en: I always do the shopping on Thursdays because the supermarket is quieter.
home and daily routine.pt: Sempre faço as compras às quintas porque o supermercado fica mais tranquilo.

home and daily routine.text: Después de comer, me gusta echarme una siesta de veinte minutos en el sofá.
home and daily routine.en: After lunch, I like to have a twenty-minute nap on the sofa.
home and daily routine.pt: Depois do almoço, gosto de tirar um cochilo de vinte minutos no sofá.

feelings and opinions.text: Me puse muy nervioso cuando tuve que hablar delante de tanta gente.
feelings and opinions.en: I got very nervous when I had to speak in front of so many people.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei muito nervoso quando tive que falar na frente de tanta gente.

feelings and opinions.text: Creo que las redes sociales nos hacen perder demasiado tiempo.
feelings and opinions.en: I think social media makes us waste too much time.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que as redes sociais nos fazem perder tempo demais.

feelings and opinions.text: Estaba tan cansada que me quedé dormida en el sofá viendo la tele.
feelings and opinions.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep on the sofa watching TV.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu estava tão cansada que peguei no sono no sofá vendo televisão.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿Qué opinas de la nueva ley sobre el tráfico en el centro?
feelings and opinions.en: What do you think of the new law on traffic in the city centre?
feelings and opinions.pt: O que você acha da nova lei sobre o trânsito no centro?

feelings and opinions.text: Me alegro mucho de que hayas conseguido el trabajo que querías.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really glad you got the job you wanted.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fico muito feliz que você tenha conseguido o emprego que queria.

feelings and opinions.text: No soporto a la gente que habla por el móvil en el cine.
feelings and opinions.en: I can't stand people who talk on their phones in the cinema.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não suporto gente que fala no celular no cinema.

feelings and opinions.text: En mi opinión, todo el mundo debería aprender al menos dos idiomas.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, everyone should learn at least two languages.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, todo mundo deveria aprender pelo menos dois idiomas.

feelings and opinions.text: Cuando me dieron la noticia, no podía creérmelo de la emoción.
feelings and opinions.en: When they told me the news, I was so excited I couldn't believe it.
feelings and opinions.pt: Quando me deram a notícia, eu não conseguia acreditar de tanta emoção.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy un poco preocupado porque mi hijo no me ha llamado hoy.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm a bit worried because my son hasn't called me today.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou um pouco preocupado porque meu filho não me ligou hoje.

feelings and opinions.text: Me molesta mucho que la gente llegue tarde sin avisar.
feelings and opinions.en: It really bothers me when people arrive late without letting anyone know.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me incomoda muito quando as pessoas chegam atrasadas sem avisar.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿No crees que sería mejor esperar un poco antes de decidir?
feelings and opinions.en: Don't you think it would be better to wait a bit before deciding?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você não acha que seria melhor esperar um pouco antes de decidir?

feelings and opinions.text: De pequeño tenía miedo a la oscuridad y dormía con la luz encendida.
feelings and opinions.en: As a child I was afraid of the dark and slept with the light on.
feelings and opinions.pt: Quando pequeno eu tinha medo do escuro e dormia com a luz acesa.

feelings and opinions.text: Sinceramente, la película me pareció aburrida y demasiado larga.
feelings and opinions.en: Honestly, I found the film boring and far too long.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, achei o filme chato e longo demais.

feelings and opinions.text: Me siento muy orgulloso de todo lo que has conseguido este año.
feelings and opinions.en: I feel very proud of everything you've achieved this year.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou muito orgulhoso de tudo o que você conquistou este ano.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy de acuerdo contigo en parte, pero no del todo.
feelings and opinions.en: I partly agree with you, but not entirely.
feelings and opinions.pt: Concordo com você em parte, mas não totalmente.

feelings and opinions.text: Ayer me sentía un poco triste, pero hoy estoy mucho mejor.
feelings and opinions.en: Yesterday I was feeling a bit sad, but today I'm much better.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ontem eu estava me sentindo um pouco triste, mas hoje estou bem melhor.

feelings and opinions.text: Me da mucha pena que vayan a cerrar la librería del barrio.
feelings and opinions.en: It makes me really sad that they're going to close the local bookshop.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fico muito triste que vão fechar a livraria do bairro.

feelings and opinions.text: ¡Qué rabia me da perder el autobús por un minuto!
feelings and opinions.en: It drives me mad to miss the bus by a minute!
feelings and opinions.pt: Que raiva me dá perder o ônibus por um minuto!

feelings and opinions.text: Pienso que el transporte público debería ser gratis para los estudiantes.
feelings and opinions.en: I think public transport should be free for students.
feelings and opinions.pt: Penso que o transporte público deveria ser gratuito para os estudantes.

feelings and opinions.text: Cuando vi a mis amigos en el aeropuerto, me puse a llorar de alegría.
feelings and opinions.en: When I saw my friends at the airport, I started crying with joy.
feelings and opinions.pt: Quando vi meus amigos no aeroporto, comecei a chorar de alegria.

feelings and opinions.text: A mí me parece que trabajas demasiado y deberías descansar más.
feelings and opinions.en: It seems to me that you work too much and should rest more.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me parece que você trabalha demais e deveria descansar mais.

feelings and opinions.text: Tengo muchas ganas de que lleguen las vacaciones de verano.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really looking forward to the summer holidays.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou ansioso para que cheguem as férias de verão.

feelings and opinions.text: Me sorprendió mucho ver a Andrés tan callado en la fiesta.
feelings and opinions.en: I was really surprised to see Andrés so quiet at the party.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei muito surpreso ao ver o Andrés tão calado na festa.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿Te parece justo pagar tanto dinero por un piso tan pequeño?
feelings and opinions.en: Do you think it's fair to pay so much money for such a small flat?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você acha justo pagar tanto dinheiro por um apartamento tão pequeno?

feelings and opinions.text: Antes me ponía muy nerviosa en los exámenes, pero ahora estoy más tranquila.
feelings and opinions.en: I used to get really nervous in exams, but now I'm calmer.
feelings and opinions.pt: Antes eu ficava muito nervosa nas provas, mas agora estou mais tranquila.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy harto de tanto ruido; creo que me mudaré a un pueblo.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm fed up with all this noise; I think I'll move to a village.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou farto de tanto barulho; acho que vou me mudar para o interior.

feelings and opinions.text: Me encanta la gente que siempre dice lo que piensa.
feelings and opinions.en: I love people who always say what they think.
feelings and opinions.pt: Adoro pessoas que sempre dizem o que pensam.

feelings and opinions.text: No estoy seguro de que sea una buena idea viajar en agosto.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm not sure it's a good idea to travel in August.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não tenho certeza de que seja uma boa ideia viajar em agosto.

feelings and opinions.text: Cuando era joven, pensaba que el dinero era lo más importante.
feelings and opinions.en: When I was young, I thought money was the most important thing.
feelings and opinions.pt: Quando eu era jovem, achava que o dinheiro era o mais importante.

feelings and opinions.text: Me dio mucha vergüenza llamar mamá a mi profesora delante de todos.
feelings and opinions.en: I was so embarrassed when I called my teacher Mum in front of everyone.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei com muita vergonha de chamar a minha professora de mãe na frente de todos.

feelings and opinions.text: Creo que tienes razón y que deberíamos pensarlo mejor antes de firmar.
feelings and opinions.en: I think you're right and that we should think it over before signing.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que você tem razão e que deveríamos pensar melhor antes de assinar.

feelings and opinions.text: Me pone de buen humor escuchar música mientras cocino.
feelings and opinions.en: Listening to music while I cook puts me in a good mood.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ouvir música enquanto cozinho me deixa de bom humor.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿Cómo te sentiste el primer día en tu nuevo trabajo?
feelings and opinions.en: How did you feel on your first day at your new job?
feelings and opinions.pt: Como você se sentiu no primeiro dia no seu novo emprego?

feelings and opinions.text: Para mí, la amistad es más importante que el éxito profesional.
feelings and opinions.en: For me, friendship is more important than professional success.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, a amizade é mais importante que o sucesso profissional.

feelings and opinions.text: Lorena estaba muy enfadada porque nadie la había ayudado con la mudanza.
feelings and opinions.en: Lorena was very angry because nobody had helped her with the move.
feelings and opinions.pt: A Lorena estava muito brava porque ninguém a tinha ajudado com a mudança.

feelings and opinions.text: Me imagino que estarás muy contento con tu nuevo coche.
feelings and opinions.en: I imagine you must be very happy with your new car.
feelings and opinions.pt: Imagino que você esteja muito contente com o seu carro novo.

feelings and opinions.text: Prefiero no opinar sobre política cuando estoy con mi familia.
feelings and opinions.en: I prefer not to give my opinion on politics when I'm with my family.
feelings and opinions.pt: Prefiro não opinar sobre política quando estou com a minha família.

feelings and opinions.text: Me arrepiento de no haber estudiado música cuando era niño.
feelings and opinions.en: I regret not studying music when I was a child.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu me arrependo de não ter estudado música quando era criança.

feelings and opinions.text: ¡Qué alivio sentí cuando por fin encontramos al perro en el parque!
feelings and opinions.en: I felt so relieved when we finally found the dog in the park!
feelings and opinions.pt: Que alívio senti quando finalmente encontramos o cachorro no parque!

feelings and opinions.text: Creo que la ciudad sería más agradable con más parques y menos coches.
feelings and opinions.en: I think the city would be nicer with more parks and fewer cars.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que a cidade seria mais agradável com mais parques e menos carros.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Buenos días, ¿qué tal ha pasado el fin de semana con sus nietos?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Good morning, how was your weekend with your grandchildren?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, como foi o fim de semana com os seus netos?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Hola, Manuel, ¿ya habéis vuelto de las vacaciones en la playa?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Hi Manuel, are you all back from your beach holiday already?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Oi, Manuel, vocês já voltaram das férias na praia?

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Ha visto que han abierto una panadería nueva en la esquina?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you seen they've opened a new bakery on the corner?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor viu que abriram uma padaria nova na esquina?

small talk with a neighbour.text: El ascensor lleva tres días estropeado y nadie viene a arreglarlo.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The lift has been broken for three days and nobody's come to fix it.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O elevador está quebrado há três dias e ninguém vem consertar.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Anoche se oía música muy alta en el tercero hasta las dos.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Last night you could hear very loud music on the third floor until two.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Ontem à noite dava para ouvir música muito alta no terceiro andar até as duas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¡Qué bonitas están este año las flores de su balcón!
small talk with a neighbour.en: The flowers on your balcony look so lovely this year!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como estão bonitas este ano as flores da sua varanda!

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Sabe si la reunión de vecinos es el martes o el miércoles?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know if the residents' meeting is on Tuesday or Wednesday?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor sabe se a reunião de condomínio é na terça ou na quarta?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Cuando llegué al edificio, la señora del quinto ya vivía aquí.
small talk with a neighbour.en: When I came to the building, the lady on the fifth floor already lived here.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Quando cheguei ao prédio, a senhora do quinto andar já morava aqui.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si necesita algo mientras estamos fuera, llame a mi hermano.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you need anything while we're away, call my brother.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se precisar de alguma coisa enquanto estivermos fora, ligue para o meu irmão.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Le importaría recoger un paquete mío si llega mañana por la mañana?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Would you mind taking in a parcel for me if it arrives tomorrow morning?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor se importaria de receber um pacote meu se chegar amanhã de manhã?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Su hijo ha crecido muchísimo; la última vez que lo vi era un bebé.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your son has grown so much; the last time I saw him he was a baby.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O seu filho cresceu muito; da última vez que o vi era um bebê.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Dicen que van a pintar la fachada del edificio en primavera.
small talk with a neighbour.en: They say they're going to paint the front of the building in spring.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Dizem que vão pintar a fachada do prédio na primavera.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Qué tal se encuentra su marido después de la operación?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How is your husband doing after the operation?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como está o seu marido depois da cirurgia?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Antes había un bar muy bonito en la planta baja, pero cerró.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There used to be a lovely bar on the ground floor, but it closed.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Antes havia um bar muito bonito no térreo, mas fechou.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Este verano iremos al pueblo, así que el piso estará vacío en agosto.
small talk with a neighbour.en: This summer we'll go to our home village, so the flat will be empty in August.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Neste verão vamos para o interior, então o apartamento vai ficar vazio em agosto.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Ha visto qué tiempo tan bueno hace hoy para ser noviembre?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you noticed how nice the weather is today for November?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor viu que tempo bom está fazendo hoje para novembro?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Su perro es muy simpático; ¿cómo se llama?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your dog is very friendly; what's its name?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O seu cachorro é muito simpático; como ele se chama?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Perdone, creo que este sobre es suyo; lo dejaron en mi buzón.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Excuse me, I think this envelope is yours; it was left in my letterbox.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Com licença, acho que este envelope é seu; deixaram na minha caixa de correio.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Me han dicho que el chico del segundo se va a vivir a Alemania.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've heard the young man on the second floor is moving to Germany.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Me disseram que o rapaz do segundo andar vai morar na Alemanha.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¡Cuánto tiempo sin verla, doña Carmen, pensaba que estaba de viaje!
small talk with a neighbour.en: Long time no see, Carmen, I thought you were away!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Quanto tempo sem ver a senhora, dona Carmen, achei que estava viajando!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si quiere, mañana le subo la compra, que veo que le pesa mucho.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you like, I'll carry your shopping up tomorrow, as I can see it's very heavy for you.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se quiser, amanhã levo suas compras lá para cima, porque vejo que pesam muito para a senhora.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Usted también se ha quedado sin agua caliente esta mañana?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you also been left without hot water this morning?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A senhora também ficou sem água quente hoje de manhã?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mi vecina de enfrente me regaló unos tomates de su huerto.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My neighbour across the landing gave me some tomatoes from her vegetable garden.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Minha vizinha da frente me deu uns tomates da horta dela.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Hace años, todos los vecinos nos conocíamos y celebrábamos juntos las fiestas.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Years ago, all of us neighbours knew each other and celebrated the festivities together.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Anos atrás, todos os vizinhos se conheciam e celebravam juntos as festas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Perdone el ruido de ayer; estábamos montando unos muebles nuevos.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Sorry about the noise yesterday; we were putting together some new furniture.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe o barulho de ontem; estávamos montando uns móveis novos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Dicen que en la fiesta del barrio del sábado habrá orquesta y fuegos artificiales.
small talk with a neighbour.en: They say there'll be a band and fireworks at Saturday's neighbourhood party.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Dizem que na festa do bairro de sábado vai ter banda e fogos de artifício.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Creo que el nuevo portero es muy amable y muy trabajador.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I think the new caretaker is very kind and very hardworking.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Acho que o novo porteiro é muito gentil e muito trabalhador.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le dejaré las llaves para que pueda regar mis plantas.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'll leave you the keys so you can water my plants.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vou deixar as chaves com a senhora para que possa regar minhas plantas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Cuántos años lleva usted viviendo en este barrio tan tranquilo?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How many years have you been living in this quiet neighbourhood?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Há quantos anos o senhor mora neste bairro tão tranquilo?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ayer vi a su hija en el parque con una amiga; está guapísima.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Yesterday I saw your daughter in the park with a friend; she looks lovely.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Ontem vi a sua filha no parque com uma amiga; ela está lindíssima.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Hace mucho frío en el portal; ¿sabe si funciona la calefacción?
small talk with a neighbour.en: It's very cold in the entrance hall; do you know if the heating's working?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Está muito frio na entrada do prédio; o senhor sabe se o aquecimento está funcionando?

small talk with a neighbour.text: La semana que viene cambiarán las ventanas de todo el edificio.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Next week they'll replace the windows in the whole building.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Na semana que vem vão trocar as janelas do prédio todo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Me encantaría invitarlos a tomar café un día de estos.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'd love to invite you round for coffee one of these days.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu adoraria convidar vocês para tomar um café um dia desses.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Ya se ha enterado de que el señor Ramírez se jubila este mes?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you heard that Mr Ramírez is retiring this month?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: A senhora já ficou sabendo que o senhor Ramírez vai se aposentar este mês?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Cuando nos mudamos aquí, ustedes fueron los primeros en darnos la bienvenida.
small talk with a neighbour.en: When we moved here, you were the first to welcome us.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Quando nos mudamos para cá, vocês foram os primeiros a nos dar as boas-vindas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¡Qué bien huele desde el rellano, seguro que está haciendo un cocido!
small talk with a neighbour.en: It smells so good from the landing, I bet you're making a stew!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que cheiro bom dá para sentir do corredor, aposto que a senhora está fazendo um cozido!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si oye algo raro en mi piso esta semana, avíseme, por favor.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you hear anything strange in my flat this week, please let me know.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se ouvir algo estranho no meu apartamento esta semana, me avise, por favor.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Los niños del cuarto jugaban al balón en el patio todas las tardes.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The children from the fourth floor used to play ball in the courtyard every afternoon.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As crianças do quarto andar jogavam bola no pátio todas as tardes.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Qué le parece la idea de poner un jardín en la azotea?
small talk with a neighbour.en: What do you think of the idea of putting a garden on the roof terrace?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O que o senhor acha da ideia de fazer um jardim na cobertura?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bueno, le dejo, que llego tarde al trabajo; ¡que tenga un buen día!
small talk with a neighbour.en: Well, I'll let you go, I'm late for work; have a nice day!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom, vou indo, que estou atrasado para o trabalho; tenha um bom dia!

phone calls and appointments.text: Buenos días, llamo para pedir cita con la doctora García.
phone calls and appointments.en: Good morning, I'm calling to make an appointment with Dr García.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Bom dia, estou ligando para marcar uma consulta com a doutora García.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Podría decirle a Julia que me devuelva la llamada cuando pueda?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you ask Julia to call me back when she can?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderia pedir à Julia para me retornar a ligação quando puder?

phone calls and appointments.text: Lo siento, la señora Pérez no está en este momento; ¿quiere dejarle un mensaje?
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm sorry, Mrs Pérez isn't here at the moment; would you like to leave her a message?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Sinto muito, a senhora Pérez não está no momento; quer deixar um recado?

phone calls and appointments.text: Te llamé tres veces ayer, pero tenías el móvil apagado.
phone calls and appointments.en: I called you three times yesterday, but your mobile was off.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te liguei três vezes ontem, mas seu celular estava desligado.

phone calls and appointments.text: Me gustaría cambiar mi cita del lunes al miércoles por la tarde.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to move my appointment from Monday to Wednesday afternoon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu gostaria de mudar minha consulta de segunda para quarta à tarde.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Tiene algún hueco libre esta semana para cortarme el pelo?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you have a free slot this week to cut my hair?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você tem algum horário livre esta semana para cortar meu cabelo?

phone calls and appointments.text: Perdona, se corta la llamada; te vuelvo a llamar en cinco minutos.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, the call keeps cutting out; I'll call you back in five minutes.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpa, a ligação está cortando; te ligo de novo em cinco minutos.

phone calls and appointments.text: La recepcionista me dijo que la próxima cita disponible era en diciembre.
phone calls and appointments.en: The receptionist told me the next available appointment was in December.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A recepcionista me disse que o próximo horário disponível era em dezembro.

phone calls and appointments.text: Antes llamaba a mi madre todas las noches, pero ahora le escribo mensajes.
phone calls and appointments.en: I used to call my mother every night, but now I send her messages.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Antes eu ligava para a minha mãe todas as noites, mas agora mando mensagens.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿De parte de quién le digo que ha llamado, por favor?
phone calls and appointments.en: Who shall I say called, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quem eu digo que ligou, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mañana a las diez tengo cita en el banco para hablar de la hipoteca.
phone calls and appointments.en: Tomorrow at ten I have an appointment at the bank to talk about the mortgage.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Amanhã às dez tenho um horário no banco para falar sobre o financiamento da casa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si no puede venir, avísenos con al menos veinticuatro horas de antelación, por favor.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you can't come, please let us know at least twenty-four hours in advance.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se não puder vir, avise-nos com pelo menos vinte e quatro horas de antecedência, por favor.

phone calls and appointments.text: Estuve casi media hora esperando al teléfono con una música horrible.
phone calls and appointments.en: I spent almost half an hour on hold listening to horrible music.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Fiquei quase meia hora esperando no telefone com uma música horrível.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Me podría repetir el número más despacio, que no lo he apuntado?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you repeat the number more slowly, as I haven't written it down?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderia repetir o número mais devagar, porque eu não anotei?

phone calls and appointments.text: Le confirmo su cita para el jueves día doce a las cinco y media.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can confirm your appointment for Thursday the twelfth at half past five.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Confirmo sua consulta para quinta-feira, dia doze, às cinco e meia.

phone calls and appointments.text: Creo que sería mejor hablarlo por teléfono que por correo electrónico.
phone calls and appointments.en: I think it would be better to discuss it on the phone than by email.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Acho que seria melhor conversar sobre isso por telefone do que por e-mail.

phone calls and appointments.text: Cuando sonó el teléfono, yo estaba en la ducha y no pude contestar.
phone calls and appointments.en: When the phone rang, I was in the shower and couldn't answer.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quando o telefone tocou, eu estava no banho e não pude atender.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿A qué hora le viene mejor que pasemos a recoger el coche?
phone calls and appointments.en: What time suits you best for us to come and pick up the car?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Que horário fica melhor para o senhor para passarmos para buscar o carro?

phone calls and appointments.text: He llamado al técnico y vendrá a revisar la caldera el viernes.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've called the technician and he'll come to check the boiler on Friday.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Liguei para o técnico e ele vai vir revisar a caldeira na sexta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Disculpe, creo que se ha equivocado de número; aquí no vive ningún Alberto.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I think you've got the wrong number; there's no Alberto here.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, acho que o senhor ligou para o número errado; aqui não mora nenhum Alberto.

phone calls and appointments.text: Te mando un mensaje cuando salga del trabajo y quedamos en el centro.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll send you a message when I leave work and we'll meet in town.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te mando uma mensagem quando sair do trabalho e a gente se encontra no centro.

phone calls and appointments.text: La cita con el abogado duró más de lo que esperábamos.
phone calls and appointments.en: The appointment with the lawyer lasted longer than we expected.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A reunião com o advogado durou mais do que esperávamos.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Podría pasarme con el departamento de atención al cliente, por favor?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you put me through to customer service, please?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderia me transferir para o atendimento ao cliente, por favor?

phone calls and appointments.text: Se me olvidó la cita del dentista y tuve que pagarla igualmente.
phone calls and appointments.en: I forgot my dentist appointment and had to pay for it anyway.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Esqueci a consulta do dentista e tive que pagar mesmo assim.

phone calls and appointments.text: Llámame esta noche si quieres y hablamos con más calma.
phone calls and appointments.en: Call me tonight if you like and we'll talk more calmly.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me liga hoje à noite se quiser e a gente conversa com mais calma.

phone calls and appointments.text: El médico solo atiende por las mañanas, de nueve a dos.
phone calls and appointments.en: The doctor only sees patients in the mornings, from nine to two.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O médico só atende de manhã, das nove às duas.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Sería posible adelantar la cita a esta misma semana?
phone calls and appointments.en: Would it be possible to bring the appointment forward to this week?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Seria possível antecipar a consulta para esta mesma semana?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi abuelo nunca quería usar el móvil y solo llamaba desde casa.
phone calls and appointments.en: My grandfather never wanted to use a mobile and only made calls from home.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Meu avô nunca queria usar celular e só ligava de casa.

phone calls and appointments.text: Estaré en una reunión toda la mañana, así que llámame después de comer.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll be in a meeting all morning, so call me after lunch.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou estar numa reunião a manhã toda, então me liga depois do almoço.

phone calls and appointments.text: Para pedir cita, tiene que llamar a partir de las ocho de la mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: To make an appointment, you have to call from eight in the morning.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Para marcar consulta, o senhor tem que ligar a partir das oito da manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ayer estuve hablando por teléfono con Inés durante más de dos horas.
phone calls and appointments.en: Yesterday I was on the phone with Inés for more than two hours.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ontem fiquei falando ao telefone com a Inês por mais de duas horas.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Te importa si te llamo más tarde, que ahora estoy conduciendo?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you mind if I call you later, as I'm driving right now?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você se importa se eu te ligar mais tarde, que agora estou dirigindo?

phone calls and appointments.text: Nadie contestaba en la oficina, así que dejé un mensaje en el contestador.
phone calls and appointments.en: Nobody answered at the office, so I left a message on the answering machine.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Ninguém atendia no escritório, então deixei uma mensagem na secretária eletrônica.

phone calls and appointments.text: Me quedé sin batería justo cuando iba a llamar a un taxi.
phone calls and appointments.en: My battery died just when I was about to call a taxi.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Fiquei sem bateria justo quando ia chamar um táxi.

phone calls and appointments.text: Tengo cita con el veterinario el martes porque el gato no come bien.
phone calls and appointments.en: I have an appointment with the vet on Tuesday because the cat isn't eating well.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tenho consulta com o veterinário na terça porque o gato não está comendo bem.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Me puede dar su nombre completo y un número de contacto?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can you give me your full name and a contact number?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Pode me dar seu nome completo e um número de contato?

phone calls and appointments.text: Le llamaremos en cuanto tengamos los resultados de las pruebas.
phone calls and appointments.en: We'll call you as soon as we have the test results.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vamos ligar para o senhor assim que tivermos os resultados dos exames.

phone calls and appointments.text: Siento no haberte cogido el teléfono antes, pero estaba en el cine.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry I didn't pick up earlier, but I was at the cinema.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpa não ter atendido antes, mas eu estava no cinema.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si llamas antes de las doce, quizá todavía te den cita para hoy.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you call before twelve, they might still give you an appointment for today.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se você ligar antes do meio-dia, talvez ainda consiga um horário para hoje.

phone calls and appointments.text: Me gustaría anular la reserva que hice para el sábado por la noche.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to cancel the booking I made for Saturday night.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu gostaria de cancelar a reserva que fiz para sábado à noite.
